notes.title: Playtest Extended! Patch 0.0.4M Now Live
notes.notes:
Thanks so much for everyone that has joined the playtest and provided feedback, it's going so well that we are going to extend it for a few more days! Lots of players are really enjoying the experience, in particular the unique twists and story that opens up near the end of the build.

Also.. people seems to really enjoy kicking seagulls 😂



We have also just dropped a new patch to improve the new player experience, and we have even more plans for this as we go.


Patch 0.0.4M
The handbook guide has been overhauled and now allows you to play (and replay) tutorials on various topics, and includes a handy search function.

You can now equip tools from the selected character box without opening the character sheet.

The character list no longer shows need stats, and instead shows the character occupation (we have more planned for this in the future).

Relaxing at a fire now recovers energy slowly (previously it only stopped energy from decreasing). Note that this is not intended to replace beds. This is significantly slower that sleeping in a bed during the day, and much slower than sleeping in a bed at night.

Automated relaxing was previously based on whether mood was low, now it will also take into account whether energy is low.

Replaced some music tracks that may have youtube content ID flags.

Seagulls can now steal waste from large waste piles and tiny waste pile pickups (what a shame….)

Characters now have Relax on the lowest priority, so they will prefer any other tasks, and wont interrupt tasks to go and relax.

Characters that relax at a fire (automatically) will interrupt it to go do a job if there is one available, unless you manually gave them the relax command.

Events now also show in the center of the screen so you can quickly notice them, they disappear quickly but stay longer in the event list on the right hand side.

Increased Waste Bin storage amount from 15 to 30 (this is a temporary change for the demo since it doesn’t have other ways to deal with waste).

Moved the handbook button to make it stand out more.

Added a menu button to the top of the interface.

Added a tutorial about accessing the tutorials…

The new day summary will now show some quick tips, which include very short tips about things you may have missed along the way.

The new day summary includes a reminder to check the character sheet to find out why your characters are losing resolve.

Added a note to the workpost about enabling jobs in character sheets, and added requires workpost to the relative area in the character sheet.

Added a Help button to the escape menu, which takes you to the tutorials in the handbook.

Added a note about water barrels in the Food Crate & Provisions dialogs.

Added a description to the science boost dialog.

When starting a new game with the Default or Cozy survivor group, you now start with a coconut shell.

Opening escape menu or handbook should now cancel any current building placement action

Pressing the character sheet keybind (default C) will now select a character and open the sheet if no character was selected.

Changes to the research tree to make the categories more obvious.

Replaced the colony island guide with a tutorial popup.

Fixed the character sheet missing the dark background blockout.

Fixed a bug where there was a tiny chance the keypad could spawn on an island crumble.






Oceaneers Steam Playtest Continues!
Sign up directly from our Steam Page if you are interested in taking part in the playtest.


Visit the Oceaneers Steam page and click the "Request Access" button!

You can also check discord for a list of known bugs, community suggestions and upcoming plans!


Known Bugs

notes.title: Playtest Patch 0.0.4J Now Live
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone providing feedback on the playtest so far, looks like everyone is having a lot of fun which is great to see! There are still a few more days left on the playtest!



We wanted to put up a patch that focuses on some improved raft controls, so here it is. Love to you hear your thoughts on the changes. More improvements to come!


Patch 0.0.4J
Raft movement changes. Right clicking with a raft selected now shows the context menu by default, you can hold CTRL just to do a move without the menu. 

You can use the Work in Area command on the ocean for characters on or near the raft to automatically do tasks in the raft work area. Some people did discover this feature previously, it has been improved and the delay before characters look for things to do has been reduced.

The raft mast can be selected to change the size of the work area. We have removed the previous work area settings for the raft only for now, and this function works regardless of whether characters have automation enabled. This was needed to simplify the process and avoid confusion, we may add back some filters later.

You can queue up Work Areas, characters automatically board, drive and work.

You can still manually move the raft, select characters and fully micromanage them as you desire (sometimes you just want to harvest one item).

When you give a character the “Drive Raft” command, the raft will automatically be selected (unless you are holding SHIFT to queue commands)

Most debris piles that gave beachwood now give +1 beachwood.

Added a “Pickup Items” category to automation workposts. Spoiled waste will only be picked up if you have the storage for it.

Automating salvaging will now include Science Cubes, Science Capsules and Bottles in the work area.

Resource tooltips now show growth conditions for plant seeds.

Renamed “Progression Guide” heading to “Starter Guide”

“Open handbook” is no longer a pre-requisite of other objectives, but it still shows as an objective.

Added a link to the feedback form when quitting the game.

Added “Build a bed” to the Starter Guide objectives.

Added new BioSoil recipe to the composter, this is now the base recipe, with fertilizer recipes to come later from higher tier resources.

Added a note to dead things like crabs, to show they need to be butchered to get the resources used in food etc.

Added a note about rain to the dirty water pool.

Added a note about more survivors to the Survivor Stories new game screen.

The “Explore the island” Story objective has been made more specific to “Read the strange note”.

Added “Send an expedition” to the Story objectives, to indicate that it is necessary to progress the story.

Fixed some typos on tools.

Fixed characters trying to automatically relax at a fire that was already full of people relaxing.

Fixed characters sometimes facing the wrong way when kicking nodes.

notes.title: Dev Diary #1 - Progress Update
notes.notes:
Happy 2025! 

It's finally time to start sharing more detailed ins and outs of the game features and start discussing them with you!

We will be doing this in a dev blog format right here on Steam. Some entries will be general updates, but we will often focus on a specific topic for each one.

Development
We have been working towards a demo and public playtests and will be sharing more regular updates. Internal testing has gone through several rounds and we are keen to get the community involved to gather feedback!

Features
There are a bunch of new features we have been working on that haven’t been revealed yet (and don’t appear in the trailer or screenshots). We are finalizing a few things before we share them, stay tuned, there is some really fun depth that might surprise you!

Meanwhile... existing features we have been working on
Character stats changes.
We have been adjusting the needs, skills and conditions systems. We also have traits planned that work with these as part of the character creator. Here is an in-progress screenshot of the latest character sheet. (We will go into some detail on these systems in one of the next dev diaries).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215726/48d986678ff5826f9b9c6b23555fc63dbe6e1612.jpg

Island inspection.
We are really excited about how island features will effect your colony and how this will tie into story and objectives. It’s going to be fun to go island hunting to find the best islands for your colony, upgrade them and add modules.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215726/ef62c3e12715596320de9d6fe316a05ef649e264.jpg

Raft building
We have been working on the raft building UI and it now features a parts list. You place everything on the raft in the dock, then the raft goes into construction and your survivors get to work. Still a work in progress, but we are happy with the direction this is going.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215726/8808be73c3a9597435125b176a8a41d95210e614.jpg

Expeditions.
The cargo system is now implemented, along with travel requirements (food/water). Resources are easy to use in the sector you are in (without inventory tetris), however, progressing to bigger and better rafts is going to be important with the cargo system to get those resources home.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215726/10e0f935534c4669890fc7449c7f21ab61e540e2.jpg


PLAYTEST
We are very close to playtests, if you are interested in early playtesting please join our discord. We will be doing several very small playtests before expanding it, so don’t worry if you miss out on a playtest round you will get a chance to provide feedback.

More to come!
Stay tuned, more dev diaries are on the way! We plan to go into more details on the story, character stats and resource systems, along with some other things we have been working on.


That wraps up this dev diary, we would love to hear your thoughts!
